info.title: Educational Management API
info.description:
A comprehensive API for managing educational records, schools, students, and certificates in Imo State.
This API provides endpoints for admin authentication, school management, student management,
certificate uploads, result searches, payments, and certificate generation.

post.description: Authenticate admin user and return JWT token

get.description: Retrieve a list of all schools with optional filtering

post.description: Register a new school in the system

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific school

delete.description: Remove a school from the system

get.description: Retrieve a list of all students with optional filtering

post.description: Register a new student in the system

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific student

delete.description: Remove a student from the system

get.description: Retrieve a list of all BEC certificates with optional filtering

200.description: List of BEC certificates retrieved successfully

post.description: Upload Excel file containing BEC certificate results

file.description: Excel file (.xlsx or .xls) containing certificate data

get.summary: Get BEC certificate by exam number
get.description: Retrieve BEC certificate details by examination number

delete.description: Remove a BEC certificate from the system

get.description: Search for student results across all certificate types

post.description: Initialize payment for certificate access or services

get.description: Verify payment status using payment reference
